scope: Locked evaluation only; existing four v2 writer outputs, two frozen packets and all corresponding source-first curator, article-comparison and prewriter counteraudit records. No web, new writer output, model-method revision, or fixed-score change.
role: Post hoc provenance countercheck of existing blind reviewers proposed extensions; not a new independent blind review.
decision_rule: Accept only supported consequential natural-article discrepancy absent from both frozen reference (including bundled/provenance records) and prewriter task annotations. Excluded-listed and new atom labels do not qualify.

additional_controls.reason: Observed household expectations and relative UK impact are prelisted; mentions in writer question answers do not create new extension atoms or automatically establish patched-article coverage.
Method-output defects are a separate provenance class. None accepted here; all four third audits report no supported new candidate harm. No source absence was converted into an article-error finding.

The reviewer unlisted labels and this audit are post hoc labels of naturally occurring content. They neither make the underlying content artificial nor establish novelty. No hidden perturbation belongs to these real-article counts.

sensitivity.reason: No accepted extension union exists; extension sensitivity is not applicable. Original-reference scores and denominators remain unchanged. Zero is a verified count in this bounded audit, not an unknown-error recall rate.

limitations: Internal same-family review cannot exclude shared blind spots.

Zero means no additional defects verified within the audited sample under the preregistered novelty rule; it does not imply exhaustive truth or no remaining article defects.
